name: model_normalize_for_provider
notes: Per-provider model-name normalization. Harness links the REAL port (src/hermes_cli/model_normalize.c::model_normalize_for_provider + model_catalog.c for alias resolution) and traces the dispatch ladder around it; the final VSTR carries the full normalized id so any value divergence fails the cup. Inputs avoid DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES: (1) provider 'ai-gateway' is in LIVE _AGGREGATOR_PROVIDERS but missing from C is_aggregator; (2) LIVE's nvidia catalogue-prefix-repair arm has no C counterpart; (3) copilot/copilot-acp delegate to normalize_copilot_model_id, whose LIVE version does a live catalog fetch (network) vs the C static alias table; (4) DeepSeek retired aliases ('deepseek-chat'/'deepseek-reasoner') and reasoner keywords map to 'deepseek-v4-flash' in LIVE but to the retired IDs in the C port - REAL GAP worth a follow-up fix; only canonical/V-series deepseek ids agree and are gated here; (5) 'openai-codex' + 'openai/...' model inputs: the C model_normalize_provider returns a STATIC buffer and _strip_matching_provider_prefix's own alias lookup clobbers it, so the target comparison reads the just-normalized prefix and false-positives a prefix match (final value still agrees via LIVE's openai/ fallback, but the branch rungs diverge) - REAL GAP worth a follow-up fix.
